text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi addresses Tunisian parliament and praises changes in Tunisia since President Ben Ali took power.
- President looks at social and child affairs.
- The Tunisian parliament ratifies a Tunisian-Libyan land transport agreement. Tunisian and Libyan ministers discuss ways of boosting economic cooperation.
- President Ben Ali discusses with farmers' association head Abdelbaki Bacha preparations for next season.
